anime_multiverse.beastwill.dragon_will.l: The Dragon's Will, an Asuran dragon's will of the Indrath line (Aether) that Sylvia gave to Arthur. A holder first borrows its grip on aether (Static Void); only a trained one becomes the Realmheart dragon-humanoid.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.dragon: Realmheart, my aether, answer: break the realm in two.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.elderwood_gua: The will of a Vritra-corrupted, Hamadryad-like grove guardian. It lends vines and emerald aura, but it pushes back: a holder who is not trained enough is overwhelmed.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.elderw: Roots of the elder grove, rise through the rot: Heartwood Lance!
anime_multiverse.beastwill.shadow_panthe: A panther of moonless dark that hushes wind and sound until it is only a rumour; the holder first borrows its reflexes, then becomes the silence it hunts in.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.shadow: Wind, hold your breath; sound, lay down your name. Moonless Hush.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.lion_will.lor: A pride-king lion's will: the first stage lends a lion's poise and a cub's roar, the second makes a lion king whose howl shakes the ground.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.lion: Kingdom of the golden plain, hear your sovereign. Roar, and the world shall kneel.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.ridge_wolf_wi: The will of the elder wolf that rules a mountain ridge: it never loses a trail, hamstrings fleeing prey and calls its pack to the kill.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.ridge_: Moon, lend me your teeth; ridge, close your jaws. The Long Hunt.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.thunder_fang_: The will of a three-bodied storm beast: a lion's fangs, a ram's charge and a venomous serpent tail, all crackling with thunder.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.thunde: Lion bites, ram breaks, serpent binds; sky, answer the three of us. Skyfall of the Chimera.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.crested_boar_: The will of a highland tusker so old its bristle crest has turned to stone: it does not dodge, it walks through the blow and gores.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.creste: Stone crest, unbroken tusk: Avalanche, trample the path!
anime_multiverse.beastwill.wind_skimmer_: The will of an elder raptor that skims the top of the gale: it never lands hard, fades into clouds and falls on prey from the wind.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.wind_s: Open, sky; fall, wind, in a single line. Skimmer's Tempest.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.flame_serpent: The will of an elder serpent whose scales glow like cooling lava: it senses living heat, hides in heat haze, spits molten venom and coils around what it kills.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.flame_: Cinder coil, molten fang: scorch the sky, Cremation!
anime_multiverse.beastwill.ammit_will.lo: A mana beast of the dust-lands that weighs the heart of every foe it meets and devours the ones found wanting; its will lets a tamer feel the weight of sin and tear it out.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.ammit: Feather and heart, scales of the dead: Ammit devours the unworthy!
anime_multiverse.beastwill.cerberus_will: A giant mana hound with three snarling heads whose will keeps a threshold: nothing it guards gets out and nothing unwelcome gets in.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.cerber: Three jaws, one gate: Hellgate, shut for good!
anime_multiverse.beastwill.fenrir_will.l: The monstrous wolf, son of Loki, who grew without limit: he snapped the chains Leyding and Dromi, was bound only by Gleipnir at the price of Tyr's hand, and at Ragnarok breaks free to swallow the sun and devour Odin. A will, not a bond: no wolf follows its holder.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.fenrir: Gleipnir, break! The sun is swallowed, the All-Father falls: Ragnarok comes!
A green-furred ghost hound of the moors whose paws leave no sound; its will carries a death-omen across mist and heather in a three-fold bark.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.cu_sit: Moor-mist, silent paw: bark three times, Third Bark, sound the omen!
A fox spirit whose tails grow with its mana; its will bends light and mind with foxfire and glamour.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.kitsun: Nine tails, one dream. Lantern-fire, light the false road. Kitsune, wake the world asleep.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.nue_will.name: Nue Will
anime_multiverse.beastwill.nue_will.lore: A night-chimera wrapped in black cloud whose cry is an omen: those who hear it fall ill and are struck by lightning.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.nue: Black cloud, cover the moon. Night-bird, cry the omen. Nue, call the storm.
A winged stallion of pure light whose hoofbeat can open a healing spring and whose gallop crosses the sky like a falling star.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.pegasu: Hippocrene, carry me; heaven, lend me your bolt. Star Gallop.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.minotaur_will: A bull-headed giant of the stone maze, enraged and untiring, who always finds the way to its prey.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.minota: Stone walls, close; no road leads out. Asterion, bellow: the maze has a heart.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.sphinx_will.l: A winged stone-lion with a calm human face that asks one question and keeps the silence for those who cannot answer.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.sphinx: Four at dawn, two at noon, three at dusk: answer, or be still. The Last Riddle.
Apep, the endless serpent that swallows Ra's sun each dusk. Its will has a Vritra-like decay: light dims and life withers around its gaze.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.apophi: Dusk without end, serpent of the dark: swallow the sun, Apep!
The Hafgufa floats like an island and breathes a sweet scent that draws fish, then ships, into its maw. Its will is a patient, heavy tide.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.hafguf: Sweet mist, rise. Deep jaws, open. Island of the dark water, swallow the fleet.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.hydra_will.lo: The Lernaean Hydra of the marsh: poison breath, many necks, heads that grow back when cut. Its will mends flesh but keeps the holder in pain.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.hydra: Cut one, two shall grow. Nine throats, one hunger. Hydra, bite.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.jormungandr_w: The Midgard Serpent circles the world sea with its tail in its mouth; its venom meets Thor at Ragnarok.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.jormun: Ring of the world, close your jaws. Midgard's coil, drown the shore.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.kraken_will.l: The Kraken of the northern sea: arms that seize ships, ink that blots the sea and a whirlpool when it dives.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.kraken: Dark below the keel, arms of the deep. Kraken, drag the fleet to the floor.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.nidhoggr_will: Nidhoggr gnaws Yggdrasil's roots in Niflheim and feeds on the dead; its will carries rot and hunger, a Vritra-like decay.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.nidhog: Root of the world, grow thin. Niflheim, open your hunger. Nidhoggr, gnaw.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.scylla_charyb: On opposite sides of the narrow strait: Scylla with six snapping dog heads on the cliff, Charybdis the whirlpool beneath.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.scylla: Cliff above, current below; no helm may pass. Between Scylla and Charybdis.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.typhon_will.l: Typhon, Father of Monsters: a hundred dragon heads that roar with every voice, fire in the eyes and vipers at the thighs.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.typhon: A hundred throats, one storm; hear every voice and break. Hundred-Headed Tempest.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.yamata_no_oro: The eight-headed, eight-tailed serpent of Izumo, with eyes red as winter cherries, brought floods and was drowned in sake.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.incant.yamata: Eight heads drink, eight valleys fill; sake, bring sleep. Eight Valleys Flood.
